payload.text: Browser discovery has one home, in the `artifact` crate, and prez's `pdf`, `present` and `browser` call it. It keeps prez's probe order (`--browser`, then the Chromium family by macOS app path, then by `PATH` name) and its refusal that lists every path tried, and prez's discovery tests pass from their new home. showreel's `video` calls the same finder, which AC-03.4 checks.
